cases.name: inline INSERT data

same.name: comments, whitespace and the trailing semicolon do not count
sql: ALTER TABLE app.events ADD COLUMN extra String DEFAULT 'x';
ALTER TABLE app.events ADD COLUMN extra String DEFAULT 'x'
ALTER TABLE app.events ADD COLUMN extra String DEFAULT 'x';;

ALTER TABLE app.events /* a block; -- comment */ ADD COLUMN extra String DEFAULT 'x' -- trailing
;

ALTER TABLE app.events // a comment
ADD COLUMN extra String # another
DEFAULT 'x' #! and another
;

-- operation: alter_table_add_column key=table:app.events:column:extra risk=safe
ALTER TABLE app.events ADD COLUMN extra String DEFAULT 'x';
ALTER TABLE app . events ADD COLUMN extra String DEFAULT 'x';

same.name: a comment can stand between two tokens
sql: SELECT a/* c */,/* d */b FROM t;

same.name: a comment separates two tokens as whitespace does
SELECT ... FORMAT has no inline data
a column named format inside parentheses is not FORMAT
sql:
INSERT INTO t ( format , x ) -- c

same.name: comments and whitespace before the inline data of INSERT ... FORMAT
sql:
INSERT /* c */ INTO  t -- c
FORMAT CSV
1,2
;

same.name: format() and names called format in an INSERT are SQL, not a FORMAT clause
sql: INSERT INTO t SELECT format('{}', 'x') AS format FROM s;

INSERT INTO t SELECT format( '{}' , 'x' ) AS format -- c
FROM s

same.name: a table named format is not a FORMAT clause
